message: お嫁さん＝子作り

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, hello. This is Lolotte」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Lolotte! It's me, Synn Sakura!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, thank goodness. I was worried about what I'd do if I got the wrong number」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You don't need to be so nervous. Your name was clearly displayed on my end, after all」
That wasn't the only reason I was nervous, though.

name: Synn
message: 「What were you up to today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I went exploring with Amyrina. Truthfully, I wanted to invite Azel along as well, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.... Maybe Azel is... steeling himself for a lot of things right now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. That's what I figured... Still, once all of that is over, I plan to do plenty of exploring with him!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, yeah. Let's do that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What were you doing today, Mr. President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well. Some stuff around the house and... oh, I also chatted with Riesling」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, with my butler!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. While we were talking, the subject of when he first met you came up. He said he's softened up thanks to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Wasn't it you... who changed Riesling?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No... It's not like I ever set out to change him or anything like that... 」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, he's precious family to me too, after all. Naturally, I want to get along with him」
Lolotte didn't deepen her bond with Riesling simply because she's an angel.
She simply did it because she genuinely wanted to.
So even the seasoned Riesling couldn't see through to the true depth of Lolotte's kindness.

name: Synn
message: 「And you know. While we were talking... Riesling asked me to take good care of you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, of course. We are lovers, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, they went past that and said it felt like giving away a bride... ahaha\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-a bride!?」
Whoa... getting such a blatant reaction is honestly embarrassing.

name: Lolotte
message: 「A bride, a bride...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you looking it up in a guidebook?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-n-no, I am not!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A bride... huh~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I become your bride, President, you and I will... become family, won't we」

name: Synn
message: 「Your real family, Lolotte... are they in Heaven?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Angels are all like one big family. However, we do not have a father and mother like people in the Human World do」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is strictly an organizational family... an angel as genuinely caring as Amyrina is rather rare, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is why having my family grow like this... makes me very happy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, if I become your bride, surely we will have babies too...\s03」
Wait, that's still way too soon for us!

name: Synn
message: 「W-well, I'm gonna head to bed soon!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-yes! See you tomorrow」

name: Synn
message: 「...I love you, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I love you very much too\s04」
Phew~~.
Even Lolotte... gets all flustered over the idea of being a bride...
